scope: Default-off dxfRW guard rejects raw-section replay for the selected write. It does not authorize an MLINE operation, qualify the original source or live graph, or inspect other sections and their dependencies.
behavior: Policy is configured before an operation and latched per admitted write. With the guard enabled, a nonempty codec-owned raw-section vector at the actual replay boundary refuses before emission; after the finalization callback the codec again requires it empty. Active attempts to change the guard fail the write. A tentative no-raw-section receipt is visible only during finalization and expires after the attempt. Default-off writing retains ordinary raw-section behavior.

controls.asciiAndBinary: 38 focused controls: ordinary raw replay, strict clean output, initial/callback insertion, in-operation policy change, finalization setter and raw-vector swap, finalizer rejection/exception, nested write, unchanged destination sentinel and corrected same-codec retries. Four concurrent invocations passed using atomically reserved scratch directories.
controls.extraVersions: Equivalent scratch test builds passed on AC1015, AC1021 and AC1032 in both encodings; the registered test uses AC1027.
controls.physicalOutput: An independent minimal byte decoder verified section framing for default and strict ASCII/binary outputs: default has TEST_PRIVATE after the six ordinary sections; strict has only those six. The decoder checks physical framing, not native semantics or the full contents of those sections.

validation.sharedNormal: 3/3 focused tests passed; source-release inventory 628 files passed.
validation.independentReview: Reviewed guard scope and temporary directory isolation; no bypass found in the stated raw-section replay scope.
